assessed_concepts: Original source task: Evaluate the effectiveness of natural language processing for analysing student essays.
Evaluate using an ML language system as the sole assessor of student essays

markscheme.marking_summary: It can provide rapid,consistent preliminary scoring across many submissions. However,training bias may disadvantage language varieties and an opaque score can be difficult to challenge; nuanced reasoning may be missed. Human moderation,transparent criteria and testing across student groups are needed,so sole automated assessment is not justified merely by speed.
